Definition: a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress
BiblicalUsage: Meruwtsah is a running, a race, the act of running itself. 2 Samuel 18:27 has the watchman say the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, and Jeremiah 8:6 has every man turn to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe running shows the heart: Ahimaaz ran with good tidings, and Judah ran headlong into battle without repenting.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
